notes.title: Soul Nexus is part of Steam Next Fest: June 2025!
notes.content: [p]This week, you can play the full first act of the game for free.[/p][p]Text your way to freedom in the [i]organic-space[/i]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600163/f6fd22bc4ab01a2710fec8c5c30628a573776661.gif"][/img][/p][p]Be sure to let us know of any feedback you have and bugs you've found through our [url="https://discord.gg/kAXP34MspS"]Discord[/url].[/p][h3][/h3]
